in_hebrew.name: Maryjane
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mary, Jane (Sea of bitterness, God's grace)
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Maryjane הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Mary: Hebrew name derived from ‘Maryam’ meaning ‘bitterness, sorrow’; Jane: derived from ‘Johanna’ meaning ‘God is gracious’; The combination Maryjane symbolizes the bitterness and hardships of life being overcome by God's grace.
